source.book: 《资治通鉴》卷六十六《汉纪五十八》
source.excerpt:
刘表故吏士多归刘备，备以周瑜所给地少，不足以容其众，乃自诣京见孙权，求都督荆州。瑜上疏于权曰：“刘备以枭雄之姿，而有关羽、张飞熊虎之将，必非久屈为人用者。愚谓大计宜徙备置吴，盛为筑宫室，多其美女玩好，以娱其耳目；分此二人各置一方，使如瑜者得挟与攻战，大事可定也。今猥割土地以资业之，聚此三人俱在疆场，恐蛟龙得云雨，终非池中物也。”吕范亦劝留之。权以曹操在北，方当广揽英雄，不从。备还公安，久乃闻之，叹曰：“天下智谋之士，所见略同。时孔明谏孤莫行，其意亦虑此也。孤方危急，不得不往，此诚险涂，殆不免周瑜之手！”
周瑜诣京见权曰：“今曹操新政，忧在腹心，未能与将军连兵相事也。乞与奋威俱进，取蜀而并张鲁，因留奋威固守其地，与马超结援，瑜还与将军据襄阳以蹙操，北方可图也。”权许之。奋威者，孙坚弟子奋威将军、丹杨太守瑜也。周瑜还江陵为行装，于道病困，与权笺曰：“修短命矣，诚不足惜；但恨微志未展，不复奉教命耳。方今曹操在北，疆场未静；刘备寄寓，有似养虎。天下之事，未知终始，此朝士旰食之秋，至尊垂虑之日也。鲁肃忠烈，临事不苟，可以代瑜。傥所言可采，瑜死不朽矣！”卒于巴丘。权闻之哀恸，曰：“公瑾有王佐之资，今忽短命，孤何赖哉！”自迎其丧于芜湖。瑜有一女、二男，权为长子登娶其女；以其男循为骑都尉，妻以女；胤为兴业都尉，妻以宗女。初，瑜见友于孙策，太夫人又使权以兄奉之。是时权位为将军，诸将、宾客为礼尚简，而瑜独先尽敬，便执臣节。程普颇以年长，数陵侮瑜，瑜折节下之，终不与校。普后自敬服而亲重之，乃告人曰：“与周公瑾交，若饮醇醪，不觉自醉。”
权以鲁肃为奋武校尉，代瑜领兵，令程普领南郡太守。鲁肃劝权以荆州借刘备，与共拒曹操，权从之。乃分豫章为番阳郡，分长沙为汉昌郡；复以程普领江夏太守，鲁肃为汉昌太守，屯陆口。
初，权谓吕蒙曰：“卿今当涂掌事，不可不学。”蒙辞以军中多务。权曰：“孤岂欲卿治经为博士邪！但当涉猎，见往事耳。卿言多务，孰若孤！孤常读书，自以为大有所益。”蒙乃始就学。及鲁肃过寻阳，与蒙论议，大惊曰：“卿今者才略，非复吴下阿蒙！”蒙曰：“士别三日，即更刮目相待，大兄何见事之晚乎！”肃遂拜蒙母，结友而别。刘备以从事庞统守耒阳令，在县不治，免官。鲁肃遗备书曰：“庞士元非百里才也。使处治中、别驾之任，始当展其骥足耳！”诸葛亮亦言之。备见统，与善谭，大器之，遂用统为治中，亲待亚于诸葛亮，与亮并为军师中郎将。

panels.title: 不能不学
panels.caption: 孙权对吕蒙说：“你如今掌事，不能不学习。”
panels.scene: Sun Quan in rust robe speaks earnestly to blue-green-robed commander Lu Meng in a military reception room.

evidence.excerpt: 卿今当涂掌事，不可不学

panels.title: 军务太多了
panels.caption: 吕蒙推辞：“军中事情这么多……”
panels.scene: Lu Meng gestures toward a table with plain military rolls and maps without legible markings; Sun Quan listens.

panels.title: 先读些往事
panels.caption: 孙权说：“又不是要你做专门研究经书的人，只要广泛读一些，了解往事。”
panels.scene: Sun Quan points gently to a small stack of bamboo scrolls, inviting Lu Meng to read.

panels.title: 忙也有收获
panels.caption: “你说忙，难道比我还忙？我常读书，自觉大有收获。”
panels.scene: Sun Quan holds one open blank bamboo scroll and speaks confidently; Lu Meng becomes thoughtful.

evidence.excerpt: 孤常读书，自以为大有所益

panels.title: 终于开始了
panels.caption: 吕蒙于是开始读书。
panels.scene: Lu Meng studies bamboo scrolls attentively at a quiet desk by lamplight, same adult face and clothing.

panels.title: 一谈就不同
panels.caption: 后来鲁肃经过寻阳，与吕蒙交谈，惊讶地发现他的才略大有长进。
panels.scene: Lu Su in brown and cream talks with Lu Meng across a table, surprised by his confident explanation.

evidence.excerpt: 及鲁肃过寻阳，与蒙论议

panels.title: 刮目相看
panels.caption: 吕蒙笑着说：“分别几天，就该重新看待别人了，您怎么现在才发现？”
panels.scene: Warm two-person close scene: Lu Meng smiles modestly, Lu Su raises brows in delighted respect.

evidence.excerpt: 士别三日，即更刮目相待

panels.title: 结交为友
panels.caption: 鲁肃拜见吕蒙的母亲，与吕蒙结为朋友后才离去。
panels.scene: Respectful final scene: Lu Su bows to Lu Meng elderly mother seated in purple robe; Lu Meng stands beside her, warm family courtyard.

generation.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: a finished Histree vintage Chinese lianhuanhua story atlas, exactly 8 sequential illustrations on ONE image. Primary request: 孙权劝学. Composition: STRICT equal rectangular grid of TWO columns and 4 rows. Read left to right, top to bottom. All row heights equal, all column widths equal. Canvas target 1024 x 1280. Narrow straight cream gutters, maximum 4 pixels; no outer margin, no header/footer; every scene fills its own complete LANDSCAPE cell. No merged panels, insets, or changes in layout.
Style: classic 1950s-1960s Chinese small-picture storybook, early Shanghai Animation folk-art sensibility. Graceful expressive fine ink outlines, hand-painted gouache, mineral blue/green, muted cinnabar and ochre, textured warm cream paper, restrained humor and human facial expressions. Rich but legible environments; varied wide/medium/close shots. NOT modern anime, 3D, glossy or photorealistic. Ancient China, no modern objects. No words, letters, numbers, captions, speech balloons, calligraphy, watermark or symbols that look like writing ANYWHERE. Clothing and face continuity within the atlas is essential.
Characters and invariants: Sun Quan: young-middle-aged lord in rust-red robe, short dark beard, dark cap. Lu Meng: sturdy adult commander, blue-green robe over simple lamellar shoulder armor, black moustache; same face and clothes before and after studying. Lu Su: lean middle-aged scholar in cream and brown robe, neat beard. Lu Meng mother: elderly woman in muted purple robe, respectful portrayal. Use bamboo scrolls and bound silk rolls, no modern books or readable writing.
Scenes in this exact order:
1. Sun Quan in rust robe speaks earnestly to blue-green-robed commander Lu Meng in a military reception room.
2. Lu Meng gestures toward a table with plain military rolls and maps without legible markings; Sun Quan listens.
3. Sun Quan points gently to a small stack of bamboo scrolls, inviting Lu Meng to read.
4. Sun Quan holds one open blank bamboo scroll and speaks confidently; Lu Meng becomes thoughtful.
5. Lu Meng studies bamboo scrolls attentively at a quiet desk by lamplight, same adult face and clothing.
6. Lu Su in brown and cream talks with Lu Meng across a table, surprised by his confident explanation.
7. Warm two-person close scene: Lu Meng smiles modestly, Lu Su raises brows in delighted respect.
8. Respectful final scene: Lu Su bows to Lu Meng elderly mother seated in purple robe; Lu Meng stands beside her, warm family courtyard.

IMAGE 2 (approved older 移木立信 artwork) is the PRIMARY style reference; IMAGE 3 (newly corrected fish-refusal artwork) is a SECONDARY reference for the same approved style. Do not import reference story events, characters, sword/pole/fish props, captions or text. Draw the target in the same artistic language as images 2 and 3: strongly designed Chinese folk/early Shanghai animation characters, larger expressive heads, compact stylized adult bodies, angular expressive eyebrows and noses made with very few confident strokes, small curved eyes, humorous expressive poses, fluid varied BLACK ink contours, FLAT matte pigment blocks with only spare broad ink-wash texture. Reduce realistic anatomy, skin modeling, facial shading, brocade patterns, tiny clothing folds and detailed background rendering dramatically. Robes are mostly solid muted color fields with spare trim, NO all-over elaborate embroidery. Simplify background buildings into rhythmic geometric silhouettes, light ink washes and warm UNPAINTED cream space. Restrained indigo, ochre and cinnabar, subtle paper grain like image 2, no dense brown texture overlay. NOT realistic illustrated portraiture, glossy painting, modern anime, chibi toys, 3D or photorealism. Keep all characters ADULT unless explicitly elderly. Preserve each character's consistent identifying robe color, beard and role, but redraw their form in this stylized way. No words, numerals, letters, title, captions, calligraphy, speech bubbles, watermark or readable marks ANYWHERE, including on documents, garments or props. Ignore all text visible in the style reference. Do not add a header or footer.
